developer_dir_note: MANDATORY. Under the xcode-select default (/Applications/Xcode.app 26.6) the LillistCore compile dies with 'error: fatalError' before any test runs, producing a FALSE RED (exit 1, zero tests executed). Always set DEVELOPER_DIR to the Xcode 27 beta for this repro.
host_dependency: Observes /Applications/Lillist.app on this Mac. Not hermetic; skips (never false-fails) when the app or pluginkit is unavailable.
